name: url_percent_escape
description: Percent-encode individual reserved URL characters with uppercase hexadecimal digits; no arithmetic task.
generator_code:
import random,json,urllib.parse
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
chars={'space':' ','slash':'/','question mark':'?','ampersand':'&','hash':'#','plus sign':'+','equals sign':'=','colon':':'}
for i in range(96):
 name=list(chars)[i%8];label=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','omega'])
 p=f'URL component record {label}: character {name}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only its percent-encoding using uppercase hexadecimal. Encoding:', 'answer':' '+urllib.parse.quote(chars[name],safe='')})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the record label. Label:', 'answer':' '+label})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
